desc: Ideate approaches and select A-block square-root decomposition with offline partial subqueries as the primary plan.
Implement input parsing, block-size selection, and query classification into base_blocks plus prefix/suffix partial ranges, handling last-block and zero-remainder cases.
Generate packed partial subqueries (A_i, Y, query_id, sign) and solve them offline by sorting subqueries and B values, using Fenwick trees over B positions for active B_j <= A_i.

Compute cumulative full-A-block contributions: for each A block, sort its values, sweep sorted B to compute per-B-index block contribution, prefix-sum over original B order, update cumulative base array, and add base[Y] to queries grouped by base_blocks.
Run sample tests and verify the solution passes the public samples.
Tune block size, packing, and Fenwick loops for performance and memory constraints.
